title: Trying to generate .pyi from .pyd raises UnicodeDecodeError
body:
* Windows 10, Python 3.5.4
* Bug
* I run `stubgen Dummy` in the command line where `Dummy` is the compiled extension module `Dummy.pyd`
* I get the `UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x90 in position 2: invalid start byte` error
* I expect to have a `.pyi` file produced
* mypy 0.610  
* The full traceback is below:

> 
> Traceback (most recent call last):
>   File "c:\users\user\appdata\local\continuum\anaconda2\envs\gdbeepy35\lib\runpy.py", line 193, in _run_module_as_main
>     "__main__", mod_spec)
>   File "c:\users\user\appdata\local\continuum\anaconda2\envs\gdbeepy35\lib\runpy.py", line 85, in _run_code
>     exec(code, run_globals)
>   File "C:\Users\user\AppData\Local\Continuum\Anaconda2\envs\GDBeePy35\Scripts\stubgen.exe\__main__.py", line 9, in <module>
>   File "c:\users\user\appdata\local\continuum\anaconda2\envs\gdbeepy35\lib\site-packages\mypy\stubgen.py", line 903, in main
>     raise e
>   File "c:\users\user\appdata\local\continuum\anaconda2\envs\gdbeepy35\lib\site-packages\mypy\stubgen.py", line 900, in main
>     include_private=options.include_private)
>   File "c:\users\user\appdata\local\continuum\anaconda2\envs\gdbeepy35\lib\site-packages\mypy\stubgen.py", line 132, in generate_stub_for_module
>     pyversion=pyversion, include_private=include_private)
>   File "c:\users\user\appdata\local\continuum\anaconda2\envs\gdbeepy35\lib\site-packages\mypy\stubgen.py", line 211, in generate_stub
>     source = mypy.util.decode_python_encoding(data, pyversion)
>   File "c:\users\user\appdata\local\continuum\anaconda2\envs\gdbeepy35\lib\site-packages\mypy\util.py", line 86, in decode_python_encoding
>     source_text = source.decode(encoding)
> UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x90 in position 2: invalid start byte
